aboutTitle: What does the Case Converter do?
about: Change the capitalization of your text using uppercase, lowercase, title case or sentence case. Use it to prepare headings, labels and other text before copying the result into your document.
example: Paste "hello world" and choose UPPERCASE to get "HELLO WORLD". Choose lowercase to change it back to "hello world".

faqs.question: Can I convert more than one sentence?
faqs.answer: Yes. Paste your text into the input and choose the case you want to apply.

faqs.question: Should I review converted names and abbreviations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Review proper names, brand names and abbreviations after conversion so their capitalization matches your intended wording.
